ValidationRule.description: A Drive Date change cannot change to cross a Taxonomy effective date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: Is_Template__c = FALSE && NOT( ISNEW() ) && ISCHANGED( Drive_Date__c ) && NOT( ISBLANK( PRIORVALUE( Drive_Date__c ) ) ) && ( ISBLANK( Drive_Date__c ) || ( PRIORVALUE( Drive_Date__c ) < DATEVALUE("2024-01-22") && Drive_Date__c >= DATEVALUE("2024-01-22") ) || ( PRIORVALUE( Drive_Date__c ) >= DATEVALUE("2024-01-22") && Drive_Date__c < DATEVALUE("2024-01-22") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Drive Date change interferes with Taxonomy effective dates. Please cancel and rebook. Any scheduled donors should be managed through the Notifying Donors of Drive Change policy.
